message: Astra: Within Ya na’s investigation, what does “must ensure accuracy” reveal differently if Alex can read it, and what does your existing passage actually establish? Which uncertainty about the note’s audience deserves attention before revision? Why would more thought be worth its time rather than a small drafting attempt now, and what evidence would make waiting wiser? Could you briefly identify your finding, remaining uncertainty, and chosen next step in English, then carry out that choice?
